description: This Java source file defines the JwtTokenVerifier class, which extends OncePerRequestFilter to implement JWT token verification logic within a Spring-based web application. It handles extracting, validating, and parsing JWT tokens from HTTP requests, managing authentication context, and updating response headers and cookies related to token refresh workflow.

classes.name: JwtTokenVerifier
classes.description: A filter class that verifies JWT tokens in HTTP requests, supports token validation, refresh handling, and security context setup.

methods.name: doFilterInternal
methods.description: Overrides the method to process each HTTP request, extracting and validating JWT tokens, handling token refresh, and establishing security context.

methods.name: updateResponseWithJwtAndRefreshToken
methods.description: Generates new JWT and refresh tokens, adds the refresh token as a cookie and the access token as a header in the HTTP response.

methods.name: getAuthentication
methods.description: Creates an Authentication object based on username and authorities extracted from JWT claims.

methods.name: getJwsClaims
methods.description: Parses a JWT token string to obtain claims using the signing key.

methods.name: readRefreshTokenMapFromRequest
methods.description: Reads the refresh token from the request body, parsing it into a Map.
